method: Individual reading of all 122 paragraphs on PDF pages 34–40. No keyword-based approval; acronym contradictions, unclear references and sexual slang remain explicit barriers.
phrases: wrap my mind around
understand or mentally accept something difficult or surprising
理解；想明白
I can't wrap my mind around how quickly things changed.
我实在想不明白，事情怎么会变化得这么快。
Idiomatic mental understanding, not physically wrapping something; mind and head are common variants.
up and left
left suddenly and unexpectedly
突然就走了
He just up and left before the meeting ended.
会议还没结束，他突然就走了。
Informal up and + past-tense verb adds suddenness; up is not a separate upward movement.
go by
pass, when referring to time
过去；流逝
Ten minutes went by before anyone replied.
过了十分钟才有人回复。
Time sense; not pass a place or use a particular name.
pull up their phones
bring their phones into use to look at something
拿出手机查看
They pulled up their phones to check the address.
他们拿出手机查看地址。
Spontaneous source wording; pull up a message on a phone is a more usual way to describe displaying content. Not pull up meaning arrive.
not a bit
not a joke or a staged comic routine, in this chat context
不是在搞笑；不是演的
That wasn't a bit; I really forgot my own address.
那不是我在搞笑；我真的忘了自己的地址。
Bit here is a comedy routine, not the ordinary not a bit meaning not at all. The claim itself is not verified.
no cap
honestly; not lying, in very informal slang
真的；不骗你（俚语）
That was the best meal I've had all week, no cap.
那是我这周吃过最好的一顿，真的不骗你。
Register is internet/youth slang, not formal testimony or proof of accuracy.
whip it out
take something out very quickly; what it refers to depends on context
迅速拿出某物（具体所指取决于语境）
When I asked for the receipt, she whipped it out of her bag.
我问起收据时，她迅速从包里拿了出来。
In this quoted message it refers crudely to exposing a penis, not to an ordinary object. The teaching example deliberately uses a neutral object and is not a podcast quotation.
had no clue
did not know at all
完全不知道
I had no clue the meeting had been moved.
我完全不知道会议改了时间。
Source uses it about a picture being taken without her knowledge; not knowing about the picture is distinct from the narrator's legal characterization.
whatsoever
at all, used to emphasize a negative statement
丝毫；完全（加强否定）
I have no doubt whatsoever.
我丝毫不怀疑。
Emphasizes no recollection; not a question word despite beginning with what.
barely made a dent
made only a very small amount of progress through a large task or quantity
才处理了一点点；几乎没什么进展
We've barely made a dent in the reading list.
这份阅读清单我们才读了一点点。
Figurative progress through the lawsuit's content, not a physical dent or a claim that harm was minor.
